configuration: Seed 12345, z=10, HII_DIM=50, DIM=150, BOX_LEN=100 Mpc, two threads, default low-resolution 2LPT with all three production velocity components retained.
observable: Mass conservation; mode-count-weighted low/mid/high-k density and total-vector velocity power; continuous density and velocity-magnitude summaries; within-realization density--velocity Fourier relations; longitudinal dominance; and the paired same-seed 2LPT-minus-Zel'dovich correction fraction.
default_vs_upstream: Derived from the upstream simple perturb-field golden case; replaces per-bin spectrum/PDF comparison with broad-band and internal-physics invariants, enables KEEP_3D_VELOCITIES, and adds a same-seed Zel'dovich baseline.
knobs: SAB_DIM, SAB_HII_DIM and SAB_THREADS expose the two grid sides and OpenMP worker count; defaults are graded. Thread changes are calibration probes, not formal variants.
variant: BOX_LEN, grid geometry, k bands, mode counts and seed remain fixed. SIGMA_8 moves upward by exactly two float32 ulps, smoothly changing the fluctuation amplitude without changing random phases or the selected 2LPT branch.
altbuild: none: this single arm64 host cannot establish a portable compiler/FFT cross-build floor.

evidence.spread_how: The completed two-ulp SIGMA_8 selfcheck had bound_fraction 5.86e-6. Across one thread-layout probe and five additional seeds, low-k density/velocity band powers moved by at most 20.6%/26.0%, mid-k by 4.2%/7.6%, high-k by 3.9%/4.1%, continuous velocity summaries by 17.5%, and the paired correction by 10.9%; all six seed realizations passed, with the closest at bound_fraction 0.947. Within-realization density--velocity relations remained far tighter. Removing 2LPT made both paired corrections zero and failed at 7.36 times the bound.

warrant: Broad mode-weighted bands and continuous summaries characterize the evolved random field without grading its phases. Mass conservation tests CIC normalization. Density--velocity coherence, sign and longitudinal dominance test the production velocity reconstruction inside each realization. The paired Zel'dovich solve isolates the nonzero second-order correction: silently omitting 2LPT makes the correction vanish and violates the absolute physics bounds.
